prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original square mobile cooking game listing icon for 街角早餐铺. Please deliver an actual PNG exactly 600 pixels wide and 600 pixels high, not a larger square. Inviting morning steam with a few simple wisps. Style/medium: tactile cut-paper and soft matte toy-like editorial illustration with crisp layered edges and gentle shadows; entirely original. Match existing game palette warm cream #fffcf0, sage #70866a, coral #bc674e, golden food #d7ac65, deep olive #434a3a. The food is the large clear focal point with the shop as a simplified framing cue, readable at app-icon thumbnail size. Constraints: actual 600 x 600 square PNG under 6MB; opaque full-bleed cream background extends to all four square corners, NO rounded outer corners, no enclosing border. No people, no lettering or signage, no text, no logo, no watermark, no QR codes, no trademarked characters, no branding, no interface overlays. Do not include foods unrelated to the described Chinese breakfast game.
